title: GitHub Trending Weekly #7: Deta Surf, Networking Toolbox, HacxGPT, LTX-Video, DeepSeek-OCR Client

sections.title: Introduction
paragraphs: Today's video is GitHub trending weekly number seven, and I've got 20 of the hottest open-source projects making waves right now. From AI powered dev tools and research agents to new frameworks and crazy productivity hacks, this week's lineup is packed. So, star your favorites and let's dive into what's trending on GitHub this week.

sections.title: Deta Surf
paragraphs: Let's start with Datasurf, your new AI powered notebook that brings all your files and the web straight into your stream of thought. Built with Smevelt, TypeScript, and Rust, Surf lets you think, research, and write all in one place without juggling endless tabs or copy pasting chaos. You can ask questions about YouTube videos, PDFs, or even build tiny apps using its app generation tool. Everything is local first and open source. Your data stays yours. Think of it as an AI workspace designed not just to take notes, but to help you think better.

sections.title: Networking Toolbox
paragraphs: Next up, meet Networking Toolbox. The all-in-one offline first toolkit built for CIS admins and network engineers. It packs over 100 utilities for converting, calculating, diagnosing, and verifying server configs. All available without internet access. Fully open source under MIT. It's built to work anywhere, mobile, desktop, or in the cloud with no third party dependencies. Deploy it your way, Docker, GitHub pages, or any static host. It's fast, customizable, and privacyfriendly. Your go-to networking Swiss Army knife.

sections.title: HacxGPT
paragraphs: Next up, Hack GPT, an adversarial AI framework built to explore the edges of autonomous reasoning and model security. Inspired by Worm GPT, this open-source version safely simulates unrestricted AI behavior for testing, research, and resilience studies, all within ethical limits. It features a modular prompt layer, supports APIs like open router and deepseek, and comes with a clean Windows CLI for smooth experimentation. Think of it as a sandbox for AI autonomy. Built for researchers, not rebels.

sections.title: workflow
paragraphs: Next up, the workflow development kit. your new best friend for building reliable and durable async JavaScript. It lets you take any TypeScript function and make it resumable, observable, and bulletproof. Perfect for apps and AI agents that need to suspend and pick up right where they left off. Forget handrolled cues or YAML nightmares. This kit gives you reliability as code with simple declarative APIs. You can time travel through every step of your workflow with built-in logs, traces, and metrics. And it runs anywhere, local, Docker, or the cloud.

sections.title: LTX-Video
paragraphs: Meet LTX Video, the DIT-based video generation model capable of real-time performance. It creates 30fps videos at 1216* 704 resolution, and the upgraded LTX2 engine can even push native 4K at 48 FPS with synchronized audio. This isn't just another AI demo. It's productionready technology that plugs straight into real workflows from editing suites to VFX pipelines, letting you go from text to delivery ready footage in one step. LTX2 blends text, image, depth, and key frame control to give creators true storytelling power while keeping everything open source and efficient enough to run on consumer GPUs.

sections.title: VERT.sh
paragraphs: Meet Vert.sh, the open-source file converter that puts privacy and performance first. Unlike cloud-based converters, Vert runs entirely on your device using web assembly, meaning your files never leave your computer. Whether it's images, audio, documents, or even videos, Vert supports over 250 formats with no file size limits, no ads, and no payw walls. Just pure conversion power. Built with Spelt and TypeScript, it offers a clean, intuitive interface, and blazing fast local processing.

sections.title: ccusage
paragraphs: Ever wondered where your Claude Code tokens are going? Meet CC usage, the ultra fast open source CLI that lets you analyze your cloud code and codeex token usage right from local JSON L files with one command. Get beautiful daily, monthly, and sessionbased reports. Track costs, model usage, and even see your burn rate in real time. C usage isn't just a logger. It's a live dashboard for your AI workflows, featuring colorful tables, per model cost breakdowns, and smart compact views for terminal pros.
Plus, it integrates seamlessly with Claude desktop through the MCP server, giving you real-time token tracking inside your coding sessions.

sections.title: Lavandula
paragraphs: Next up, we've got Leandoula, a lightweight, fast, and intuitive C web framework for building modern web applications. Think of it as a no-b controllers or Express, you'll feel right at home. Leandoula gives you everything you need. Routing, middleware, logging, JSON handling, SQLite integration, even a built-in unit testing framework. It's minimal, powerful, and fun. Perfect for building maintainable backends in C fast.

sections.title: Local Deep Researcher
paragraphs: What if your AI research assistant could dig through the web, summarize sources, identify gaps, and refine its search, all without sending a single request to the cloud? Meet Local Deep Researcher, a fully local web research and report writing assistant powered by Langchain, Olama, and Langraph Studio. Just give it a topic. It automatically generates smart search queries, gathers and summarizes results, identifies what's missing, and iterates like a realer until it builds a full markdown report complete with citations. It works with your favorite local models from Llama 3 to DeepSec R1 or Quen 32B using Olama or LM Studio.

sections.title: T.T. TUI
paragraphs: Next up, a tool for coders and keyboard warriors. TT2E, a fast, lightweight, and distraction-free typing test that runs entirely in your terminal. Inspired by Monkey Type, it offers multiple test modes, time tests, fixed word counts, or typing quotes. Track your highresolution WPM graph, compare to personal bests, and dive deep into detailed performance stats, all in your terminal. With customizable themes, support for multiple languages, and persistent configuration. It's perfect for honing your typing skills without leaving your keyboard.

sections.title: Zen7 Payment Agent
paragraphs: Next, we've got Zen7 Payment Agent, the implementation of DPA, or decentralized payment agents. Zen7 payment infrastructure with automated encrypted transactions, LLMdriven intent recognition and permissionless authorization. Its multi-agent architecture supports A2A and MCP protocols, custodial and non-custodial wallets, multi-chain and multicurrency payments, all with highfrequency gasless and passwordless operations. Designed for AI agents and DAPs, it's a full stack flexible solution for the next generation of Agentic commerce.

sections.title: PAPER2WEB
paragraphs: Next up is Paper 2 Webb. Turning static research papers into interactive, explorable academic websites. Instead of a flat PDF, Paper 2 Webb uses a multi-agent system called Pwagent to transform your paper into a dynamic layout web page. Complete with multimedia responsive design and structured navigation. Built on the model context protocol, it intelligently parses assets, allocates layouts, and refineses content for balance and usability, outperforming even human design templates. With Paper 2 Web, your research doesn't just sit in a file, it comes alive online.

sections.title: DeepSeek-OCR Client
paragraphs: Next up, Deepseek OCR Client. A real-time desktop app that brings Deepseek's OCR power straight to your screen. Built with Electron, this open- source guey lets you drag and drop images, process them instantly with GPU acceleration and export results, even markdown ready in just seconds. It's fast, visual, and built for power users with CUDA enabled GPUs. Whether you're parsing research figures, receipts, or screenshots, Deepseek OCR client turns text and images into clean, usable data.

sections.title: GeoPulse
paragraphs: Meet Geopulse, your self-hosted privacy first location intelligence platform. It transforms raw GPS data from apps like Own Tracks, Overland, or Home Assistant into beautiful interactive timelines that reveal where you've been and how you move. Geopulse automatically detects trips and stays, syncs in real time, and even integrates with image so you can view your photos directly on the timeline map. Explore your journeys, track distance and activity, and get AI powered insights, all while keeping your location data 100% under your control. Whether you deploy with Docker or Kubernetes, Geopulse gives you a sleek, secure dashboard.

sections.title: HoloCine
paragraphs: Introducing Holene, the model to generate cinematic multi-shot narratives. While most texttovideo models can only create isolated clips, Holene crafts full scenes that stay consistent characters, environments, and emotions from the first frame to the last. With shotby-shot text inputs, you can shape the pacing, tone, and camera work, all while hollowene maintains visual and narrative coherence across every shot. Powered by its window cross attention and sparse inshot self attention mechanisms, holysine brings efficiency and global storytelling memory to minute long cinematic generation.

sections.title: Coral NPU
paragraphs: Up next, we've got Coral NPU, Google Research's open- source neural processing unit built for ultra- low power machine learning on edge devices. Designed for next-gen wearables, AR glasses, and smartwatches, Coral NPU brings serious ML inference performance to small form factors. It's based on a 32-bit risk-free architecture and packs matrix, vector, and scalar processors working in sync for efficient AI acceleration. With tightly coupled memory, AXI4 interfaces, and a clean open IP design, this NPU is made for anyone building the future of ondevice intelligence.

sections.title: Rex-Omni
paragraphs: Now, this one's a powerhouse. Rex Omni, a 3 billion parameter multimodal model that can literally detect anything. Built around a unified nextpoint prediction framework, it handles every major vision task, object detection, OCR, key pointing, visual prompting, even referring expressions, all with one model. You can ask it to find the cat sitting on the red couch, point to specific objects, recognize text, or detect every instance matching a visual example. It's like having a single AI brain that understands both language and vision, all through Nextpoint prediction magic.

sections.title: Tab Stash
paragraphs: Browser clutter got you down? Meet Tab Stash, a free and open- source Chrome extension that helps you stash your tabs locally to read later. With just one click, you can save all or selected tabs, organize them with tags, and restore them anytime, all offline and privacy first. No accounts, no sync, no cloud. Your data stays right on your device. It's lightning fast, supports bulk restore, and even lets you import or export your tab lists. So say goodbye to tab overload and hello to focus with tab stash to keep your browser clean and your mind clear.

sections.title: Volcano SDK
paragraphs: Next up meet Volcano SDK a TypeScript toolkit for building multi-provider AI agents that can mix and match LLMs like OpenAI Claude Mistral and more in one workflow. It features a chainable API, automatic tool selection, parallel execution, branching loops and even streaming results in real time. TypeScript first with full IntelliSense and typed errors. Volcano SDK is perfect for creating complex reusable and observable AI agents with native retries, OOTH support, and open telemetry integration for monitoring. It's built for production ready multi-agent workflows.

sections.title: PokeeResearchOSS
paragraphs: Introducing Pokey Research OSS, the open- source home of Pokey's state-of-the-art 7B deep research agent. Unlike typical chat models, this one actually browses and reads live web content to build comprehensive answers using the most current information online. It's designed for multi-turn reasoning, running multiple search and analysis loops until it finds the most accurate evidencebacked response possible. Built on a scalable 7B parameter model, it integrates search, browsing, and content parsing into one seamless research pipeline efficient enough for production use.
